presets.title: Manage layout presets
presets.description: The sidebar and dashboard a new user starts with. At their first sign-in, the first preset in this list whose Keycloak role or group they have is copied once into their own sidebar and dashboard; without a match, the “Everyone” preset is used. Changes only affect users signing in for the first time, never existing users.
